description: Decisions: docs/adr/0151-renovate-and-the-daily-vulnerability-scan.md. Renovate reads only the managers listed here, so the Cilium chart pins in the Makefile and pkg/cni/cilium stay with hack/bump-cilium-patch.sh (ADR 0119).

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Majors of anything wait for a tick on the dependency dashboard, so they open one at a time and never in a burst

The release set (ADR 0148): the Talos machinery module must equal pkg/release Pinned.Talos, and the Kubernetes libraries and controller-runtime move together. Cilium is not a Go module: its chart pins belong to hack/bump-cilium-patch.sh and no manager here reads them.
prBodyNotes: This moves a module of the pinned release set. ADR 0148 decides which Ichor release it ships in; `Pinned` in `pkg/release/release.go` must move with it (the release tests fail until it does), and a change to `api/`, the CRDs or `proto/` makes it a minor release.

packageRules.description: A Kubernetes or api-machinery major can break the CRD (fields are append-only)
